subject: Offer Letter – Twitch Software Engineer
snippet: Congratulations! We are pleased to extend an offer for the Software Engineer role at Twitch.
body_preview:
Dear Candidate,

Congratulations! We are thrilled to extend an offer of employment for the Software Engineer role at Twitch.

Please find the offer letter attached. Key details:
- Role: Software Engineer
- Start Date: June 2, 2026
- Compensation: $155,000 base + RSUs + bonus

Please review the offer and sign it by April 30, 2026.

Welcome to Twitch!
HR Team

subject: Update on your Apple application
snippet: After careful review, we have decided not to move forward with your application at this time.
body_preview:
Dear Applicant,

Thank you for your interest in Apple and for taking the time to apply for the Software Engineer position.

After careful consideration, we have decided to pursue other candidates whose experience more closely matches our current needs. This was a difficult decision, as we received many strong applications.

We appreciate your interest in Apple and encourage you to apply again in the future.

Best regards,
Apple Recruiting Team

subject: Document Request – Snowflake Offer Process
snippet: Please upload your government ID and education certificates by May 5, 2026.
body_preview:
Hi,

Congratulations on receiving an offer from Snowflake! As part of our onboarding process, we need you to upload the following documents by May 5, 2026:

1. Government-issued photo ID (passport or national ID)
2. University degree certificate or transcript
3. Previous employment letter (if applicable)

Please upload them here: https://snowflake.workday.com/docs/upload/xyz

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Snowflake HR Team

subject: We'd love to refer you – Brex
snippet: Hey! I work at Brex and saw your profile. I'd love to refer you for an engineering role.
body_preview:
Hey,

Hope you're doing well! I came across your profile on LinkedIn and was really impressed.

I work as an engineer at Brex and we're currently hiring for several engineering roles. I'd love to refer you – internal referrals get priority review.

Would you be open to having a quick 15-minute call this week?

Best,
John
